cohort: The study included 9,558 pregnancies delivered at >= 20 weeks with available outcome data.
finding: The developed probabilistic graphical model (PGM) successfully quantified context-specific risk relationships in FGR, identifying scenarios ranging from background risk to nearly 10-fold higher perinatal morbidity risk and uncovering latent interactions like the reversal of female fetal sex's protective effect in the presence of maternal diabetes.
